lines.en: label futabaspring3:
scene noonsky

{size=-2}Hey. So, remember back when the protagonist used to go to school and these pre-event monologues that take place directly before {i}we{/i} go to school made a lot more contextual sense and weren’t just weird and introspective?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}嘿。还记得主角以前还会去上学的那些日子吗?那时候,这种发生在{i}我们{/i}去上学之前的开场独白在语境上要合理得多,而不是像现在这样又古{/size}怪又自说自话。

lines.en: Me too! But alas — those days are long gone now and all we have left are the memories. Which kind of sucks because I don’t really {i}want{/i} those memories in the first place and now I can’t get rid of them.
lines.zh: 我也记得!唉,可惜那样的日子早就一去不返,留给我们的只剩下回忆。而这挺糟的,因为我打从一开始就不{i}想要{/i}这些回忆,现在却怎么也甩不掉。

lines.en: {size=-2}I kind of wish I was Jim Carrey, honestly. And that Elijah Wood could come over to my house one night and just purge them like I’m getting my stomach pumped but the stomach is actually my brain and all it digests are thoughts.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}说实话,我有点希望自己是 Jim Carrey。希望 Elijah Wood 哪天晚上能来我家,把那些记忆像洗胃一样统统清掉——只不过那个胃其实是我的大脑,而它消化的全是念头。{/size}

lines.en: Oh! I wish I was {i}reset.{/i} THAT is what I want.
lines.zh: 哦!我希望自己{i}被重置{/i}。这才是我想要的。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol1
But unfortunately, {b}THIS BITCH{/b} keeps getting to have all the fun! Pick me, God! Send Elijah Wood to {i}my{/i} house! She doesn’t even {i}have{/i} one!
lines.zh: 可惜啊,{b}这个婊子{/b}总是独享所有的乐子!选我啊,上帝!把 Elijah Wood 送到{i}我家{/i}来!她连个家都没有!

lines.en: : Maya, you don’t have some sort of...ongoing conflict with any of the teachers, do you? Because I’m starting to think one of them might be doing this. Ami wasn’t even here today...
lines.zh: : Maya,你该不会跟哪个老师……有什么一直没完的矛盾吧?因为我开始怀疑是她们中的某个人在干这事。Ami 今天甚至都没来……

lines.en: : Depends. I’m in the throes of several perpetual conflicts with a presently {i}absent{/i} teacher. Does he count?
lines.zh: : 看情况。我眼下正和一位目前{i}不在场{/i}的老师进行着好几场旷日持久的战争。他算吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Do you think Sensei would write something like this?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你觉得 Sensei 会写出这种东西吗?

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol2
: No, probably not. It’s not pretentious enough.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。这玩意儿还不够矫情。

lines.en: : There’s not a chance {i}you’re{/i} just writing it for attention, are you? Is this actually a cry for help?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}该不会只是为了博关注才写这些吧?这其实是在求救吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Please look at me more as I’ve realized that the only way I can ever win the favor of the man I like is to make all of the girls who are into him like {i}me{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : 是的。请多看看{i}我{/i}吧,因为我已经意识到,我唯一能赢得喜欢的男人青睐的办法,就是让所有喜欢他的女生转而喜欢我。

lines.en: : And you think self-degradation is the correct way to do that?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得自我贬低是达成这个目标的正确方式?

lines.en: : I don’t know. For what reason are you always engaging in that same practice?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。那你又为什么总在干同样的事?

lines.en: : Oh, easy. I’m broken.
lines.zh: : 哦,简单。我是个残次品。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol3
: Aren’t we all, Futaba? {i}Aren’t we all?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们谁不是呢,Futaba?{i}我们谁不是呢{/i}?

lines.en: : It’s kind of weird when it’s just me and you, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 只有我们两个人的时候,感觉怪怪的,对吧?

lines.en: : Why? Because you’re attracted to me? I knew the self-degradation thing would work.
lines.zh: : 为什么?因为你对我有感觉?我就知道自我贬低那招管用。

lines.en: : I don’t know. There’s just normally someone {i}else{/i} here. I feel like it’s been a long time since you and I talked on our own without Ami being the middleman.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。只是平时这里总还有{i}别人{/i}。感觉我们已经很久没有像这样单独聊过天了——没有 Ami 在中间当传声筒。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, she can only forcibly insert herself into so many people.
lines.zh: : 是啊,可她也只能强行把自己塞进这么多人里。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol4
: Uhh...do you mean...groups? That she can only...insert herself into so many {i}groups?{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……你是说……团体?她只能……塞进这么多{i}团体{/i}?

lines.en: : Yes. What did I say?
lines.zh: : 对。我刚才说的不就是这个吗?

lines.en: : Something that made her sound like a criminal.
lines.zh: : 你刚说的那话,听起来她像个罪犯。

lines.en: : I see. Well, she is under the tutelage of the very best when it comes to that.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。不过说到这个,她可是师从于顶尖高手。

lines.en: : I suppose she is, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我想也是,嗯。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol5
: Do you ever miss him? Like, not in a romantic or...sexual way. Just, like...having him around as a teacher.
lines.zh: : 你会想他吗?不是那种恋爱意义上或者……性意义上的。只是……身边有这么个老师在。

lines.en: : Do you? Because you’re practically Miss Imai’s number one fan when you rule out the girls who just want to fuck her.
lines.zh: : 你呢?毕竟把那些只想睡她的女生排除掉之后,你基本就是 Imai 老师的头号粉丝了。

lines.en: : Sometimes, yeah. Like, don’t get me wrong, I love Miss Imai. But she’s too spread thin trying to actually teach us things that she doesn’t have much time for the counseling part of the job anymore.
lines.zh: : 有时候会想,嗯。别误会,我很喜欢 Imai 老师。可她为了真的教我们点东西已经分身乏术,根本没多少时间顾及工作里心理咨询那一块了。

lines.en: : What, are you saying those extra-curricular grooming sessions in Sensei’s office actually did something for you?
lines.zh: : 什么?你是说 Sensei 办公室里那些课外的『调教』课程还真对你起作用了?

lines.en: : Well...yeah. If it wasn’t for those, I probably never would have-
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。要是没有那些,我大概永远都不会-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol6
scene futabaprotocol7
scene futabaprotocol8
scene futabaprotocol9
scene futabaprotocol10
scene futabaprotocol11
scene futabaprotocol12
: Huh.
: That was weird.
lines.zh: : 刚才那下有点怪。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol13
: Anyway, if it wasn’t for all of those counseling sessions, I probably never would have-
lines.zh: : 总之,要是没有那些心理咨询,我大概永远都不会-

lines.en: scene black
scene futabaprotocol14
: Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya?

lines.en: : What the hell?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼?

lines.en: : Fukuyama.
lines.zh: : Fukuyama。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol15
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : I was just wondering if-
lines.zh: : 我只是想问问-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol16
: Wait, {i}what?!{/i} Who the {i}fuck{/i} are you?!
lines.zh: : 等等,{i}什么{/i}?!你{i}他妈{/i}是谁啊?!

lines.en: : Uhh...Miles? I know you’re always busy, but...I mean, we’ve been sitting next to each other for a year now. And I was just wondering if-
lines.zh: : 呃……Miles?我知道你一直很忙,可是……我是说,我们都挨着坐了一年了。我只是想问问-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol17
: I don’t care what you’re wondering, {i}Miles!{/i} I was a fucking teenager three seconds ago and now I’m sitting in some office surrounded by people I don’t even know?!
lines.zh: : 我才不管你想问什么,{i}Miles{/i}!三秒钟前我还是个该死的少女,现在却坐在某个办公室里,周围全是我根本不认识的人?!

lines.en: : Yeah...time really does fly, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……时间过得真快,不是吗?

lines.en: : Why do things like this keep fucking happening to me?!
lines.zh: : 为什么这种事他妈的一直发生在我身上?!

lines.en: : Fukuyama.
lines.zh: : Fukuyama。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol18
: Hai.
: Could you-
lines.zh: : 你能不能-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol17
: And why am I just responding like it’s second nature?!
lines.zh: : 为什么我连回应都像出于本能一样?!

lines.en: : Are you good? Maybe you should go home early today? You’ve been putting in a lot of extra hours this month-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗?要不今天早点回去吧?这个月你已经加了不少班了-

lines.en: : Are you kidding me, Miles? It’s the end of the quarter and you’re trying to say she should {i}leave?{/i} There’s still so much {b}BUSINESS{/b} left to do.
lines.zh: : 你开什么玩笑,Miles?现在可是季度末,你居然说让她{i}走{/i}?还有那么多的{b}业务{/b}没做呢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Senpai. I’ve been so swamped with my own {b}BUSINESS{/b} today that I forgot everyone else was dealing with {b}BUSINESS{/b} too.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,前辈。今天我自己的{b}业务{/b}实在太多,忙得都忘了其他人也有一堆{b}业务{/b}要处理。

lines.en: : At least give me a fucking {i}exciting{/i} alternate reality if this is going to keep happening to me!
lines.zh: : 既然这种事要一直发生在我身上,起码给我一个他妈的{i}刺激{/i}点的平行世界吧!

lines.en: : Anyway, I need you to copy this spreadsheet five hundred times. And then I need you to take each of those copies and copy {i}them{/i} another one hundred times. It’s for the {b}BUSINESS.{/b}
lines.zh: : 总之,我要你把这份表格复印五百份。然后把{i}每一份{/i}再各自复印一百份。这是为了{b}业务{/b}。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol19
: That doesn’t even make sense! And it’s so much paper!
lines.zh: : 这根本说不通啊!而且太费纸了!

lines.en: : I also need you to pick up seventeen non-fat lattes from the cafe downstairs so we can all look like we’re drinking them during the mandatory team meeting at 3:00 today.
lines.zh: : 我还要你去楼下咖啡厅买十七杯脱脂拿铁,好让我们在今天三点那个强制性的团队会议上看起来都在喝。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol20
: Fukuyama, I need my tie dry-cleaned. Could you run it to the nearest laundromat for me and also pick up my kid from school? Thanks.
lines.zh: : Fukuyama,我的领带要干洗。你能不能帮我送到最近的洗衣店,顺便去学校接一下我的孩子?谢了。

lines.en: : I...what? No, I...I have to...there’s still so much {b}BUSINESS{/b} to do and-
lines.zh: : 我……什么?不,我……我还得……还有那么多的{b}业务{/b}要做,而且-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol21
: Fukuyama! The coffee maker is broken again! I thought you said you were going to fix it?!
lines.zh: : Fukuyama!咖啡机又坏了!我记得你说过你会修的吧?!

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol22
: Make that eighteen non-fat lattes then, Fukuyama. Seventeen of them with whole milk instead of non-fat. And about those copies-
lines.zh: : 那就改成十八杯脱脂拿铁吧,Fukuyama。其中十七杯换成全脂的,不要脱脂的。还有那些复印件-

lines.en: : Five hundred copies then...a hundred copies of each copy...right?
lines.zh: : 那就是五百份……每份再印一百份……对吧?

lines.en: : Right. But do it correctly this time since we’re all tired of picking up the slack when you mess things up around here.
lines.zh: : 对。不过这次要做对,我们大家已经受够了在你把事情搞砸的时候替你收拾烂摊子。

lines.en: : G...Got it. I’ll do it correctly...
lines.zh: : 明……明白了。我会做对的……

lines.en: : Oh, the boss wanted to talk to you too. So if you could swing by her office once you’re done with the copier, that’d be great.
lines.zh: : 哦,老板也想找你谈谈。所以等你用完复印机,顺便去她办公室一趟,那就再好不过了。

lines.en: : But what about my kid? Do I seriously need to hire a babysitter because Fukuyama’s too fucking slow to actually do her job?
lines.zh: : 那我的孩子怎么办?难道我真得请个保姆,就因为 Fukuyama 做事太他妈慢,连本职工作都做不完?

lines.en: : But my job is...is {b}BUSINESS.{/b} I’m not a babysitter.
lines.zh: : 可我的工作是……是{b}业务{/b}。我又不是保姆。

lines.en: : I can babysit. I’m actually great with kids. Which...might make this next part weird, but I was wondering if you wanted to maybe get a drink after work or something? I know you don’t normally tag along, but-
lines.zh: : 我可以带孩子的。我其实很会哄小孩。虽然……这么说可能让后面的话听起来有点怪,但我想问你下班后要不要一起去喝一杯什么的?我知道你平时都不参加,不过-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol23
: I’m not interested, Miles! There’s already somebody I’m involved with, so just...get back to work!
lines.zh: : 我没兴趣,Miles!我已经有交往的人了,所以就……回去干活吧!

lines.en: : Pfft...sure. Fukuyama seeing somebody? That’ll be the day. She hasn’t had a date the entire time she’s been here and it’s been...what? Five years now?
lines.zh: : 噗……得了吧。Fukuyama 在谈恋爱?那可真是太阳打西边出来了。她来这儿这么久,一次约会都没有,都……多久了?五年了吧?

lines.en: : I heard she swore off men completely after her first love ran off with some other girl when she was in college.
lines.zh: : 我听说她在大学时初恋跟别的女生跑了之后,就彻底对男人死心了。

lines.en: : Can you blame the guy? She can’t even fix a coffee maker. Imagine she’d just be a nuisance at home too.
lines.zh: : 你能怪那男的吗?她连个咖啡机都修不好。想想看,她在家里也只会是个累赘。

lines.en: : Sorry if I overstepped, Senpai. I just-
lines.zh: : 抱歉我越界了,前辈。我只是-

lines.en: : I don’t care! Now...please excuse me! I have {b}BUSINESS{/b} to do!
lines.zh: : 我不在乎!现在……失陪了!我还有{b}业务{/b}要做!

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol24
: Five hundred copies...then a hundred of each copy and...what is that? Like...50,000 copies? That’s like five whole trees...
lines.zh: : 五百份……然后每份一百份,还有……那是多少?大概……五万份?那得砍掉整整五棵树吧……

lines.en: : Then there’s the lattes from the...the cafe and...I have to Google how to fix a coffee maker and...and pick up a kid and...Do I even know how to drive?
lines.zh: : 然后是咖啡厅的……那些拿铁,还有……我还得谷歌一下咖啡机怎么修,还有……还要去接孩子,还有……我到底会不会开车?

lines.en: Futaba Fukuyama had gotten a job at CompanyCorp. shortly after graduating from a not-so-prestigious university in Tokyo.
lines.zh: Futaba Fukuyama 从东京一所不那么有名的大学毕业不久后,就在 CompanyCorp. 找了份工作。

lines.en: She’d applied to over three hundred different companies and it was the only one to make her an offer. So she became a wage slave willingly branded by the hot iron of {b}BUSINESS{/b} without an exit plan in sight.
lines.zh: 她向三百多家不同的公司投过简历,只有这一家给了她 offer。于是她心甘情愿地成了一名被{b}业务{/b}的烙铁烫上印记的社畜,看不到任何退路。

lines.en: Writing never worked out. Every publishing company she applied to wanted someone more qualified. And like the mysterious background employee said, she hadn’t even been on a date in years.
lines.zh: 写作这条路从来没走通过。她投的每一家出版社都想要资历更好的人。而且就像那位神秘的同事说的,她已经好几年没约会过了。

lines.en: By all accounts, she was more of an extra now than she’d {i}ever{/i} been. And she was always a bit of an extra in the first place, so that didn’t help her self-esteem at all.
lines.zh: 从各方面来看,她现在比{i}以前{/i}更像个路人甲了。而她本来就一直有点路人甲,这对她的自尊心一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: Her apartment was spotless, though. Just in case anyone ever {i}did{/i} come over. But after losing touch with even those she was closest to, there wasn’t really anyone she’d ever welcome in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过她的公寓一尘不染。以防万一哪天{i}真{/i}有人来。可是在连最亲近的人都失去联系之后,她本来也没什么值得欢迎的人了。

lines.en: Also, her parents died in a plane crash on their way back to Japan. This is a true thing that happened and not just something thrown in to make you feel even worse for her.
lines.zh: 还有,她的父母在回日本的途中死于一场空难。这是真的发生过的事,不是为了让你们更同情她才硬塞进去的。

lines.en: : {i}Fukuyama! Is that you out there? I can hear the anxiety from all the way in my office.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Fukuyama!外面是你吗?我在办公室里都能听见你的焦虑。{/i}

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol25
: Uhh...h...hai! Is that...the boss...speaking to me, by any chance?...
lines.zh: : 呃……在……在!请问是……老板……在跟我说话吗?……

lines.en: : What, you even forgot where my office is? Not good, Fukuyama. Not goooooood...
lines.zh: : 什么,你连我办公室在哪儿都忘了?不妙啊,Fukuyama。很不妙哦哦哦……

lines.en: : S-Sorry! I know you wanted to talk to me, but-
lines.zh: : 对……对不起!我知道您想跟我谈谈,可是-

lines.en: : Right now, if you could. The copies can wait. This is kinda time-sensitive. {b}BUSINESS{/b} and all that. I’m sure you know how it is.
lines.zh: : 就现在吧,如果可以的话。复印件可以等。这事有点急。{b}业务{/b}嘛。我相信你懂的。

lines.en: : R...Right!
lines.zh: : 明……明白!

lines.en: scene black
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Please excuse me...
lines.zh: : 失陪了……

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol26
: Oh, good. The door wasn’t locked. Why don’t you come on in and take a seat?
lines.zh: : 哦,很好。门没锁。你进来坐吧?

lines.en: : Something wrong, Fukuyama?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Fukuyama?
: Ami?……

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} my boss?...
lines.zh: : {i}你是{/i}我的老板?……

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol27
: Not anymore. You’re fired, actually.
lines.zh: : 已经不是了。事实上,你被开除了。

lines.en: : F-Fired?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 开……开除?!为什么?!

lines.en: : Also, I’m not Ami. You seem to have me confused with the prettiest, most precious girl in the whole wide world. I’m flattered, though. Truly.
lines.zh: : 还有,我不是 Ami。你大概是把我跟全世界最漂亮最珍贵的女孩搞混了。不过我还是挺受宠若惊的。真的。

lines.en: : But yeah — go ahead and grab a box from the corner over there to pack up your cubicle.
lines.zh: : 总之——去那边角落拿个箱子,把你的工位收拾一下吧。

lines.en: : Your {b}BUSINESS NUMBERS{/b} just aren’t good enough for CompanyCorp. And nobody really likes you either, so you’re negatively impacting both sales {i}and{/i} staff morale as a whole. I’m sure you know how it is.
lines.zh: : 你的{b}业务数字{/b}对 CompanyCorp. 来说就是不够好。而且也没人真的喜欢你,所以你无论在销售额{i}还是{/i}员工整体士气上都造成了负面影响。我相信你懂的。

lines.en: : I’m...not even supposed to be working here! I just {i}woke{/i} up here! And even then, it wasn’t like {i}waking{/i} up at all! It’s like I blinked and-
lines.zh: : 我……根本就不该在这里工作!我刚刚才在这里{i}醒{/i}过来!而且那根本算不上{i}醒来{/i}!就像我眨了一下眼,然后-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol28
: Blah, blah, blah. Nobody cares, okay? You think {i}I{/i} want to be sitting at some stupid desk instead of getting fucking {i}railed{/i} right now? Please.
lines.zh: :  blah blah blah。没人关心,好吗?你以为{i}我{/i}愿意坐在这张破办公桌前,而不是正被人狠狠{i}干着{/i}吗?拜托。

lines.en: : We are but the product of our own making, though. And even if it’s kind of lame, it explains why I’m so hot and successful and you’re just a boring cow in the cattle pen. Box, please.
lines.zh: : 不过我们都是自己造就的产物。就算这话有点烂俗,它也解释了为什么我又辣又成功,而你只是牛栏里一头无聊的奶牛。箱子,谢谢。

lines.en: : B...Boring?...
: I’m not boring...
lines.zh: : 我才不无聊……

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol29
: And I’m not hot. Are we just lying to ourselves now?
lines.zh: : 而且我也一点也不辣。我们现在是在自欺欺人吗?

lines.en: : I’m not, though! Not...not like {i}this!{/i} I’d never just...just let people boss me around like this!
lines.zh: : 我才没有!不是……不是像现在{i}这样{/i}!我绝不会就这么……就这么任由别人这样使唤我!

lines.en: : So you’re making like 50,000 copies of a spreadsheet because you think it’s {i}fun?{/i} Sounds pretty boring to me, babe.
lines.zh: : 所以你印五万份表格是因为你觉得{i}好玩{/i}?听起来无聊透顶啊,宝贝。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol30
: It’s a dream! We don’t always act...logically in dreams! I was just...going along with it so I could try to get out!
lines.zh: : 这是梦!我们在梦里并不总是……合乎逻辑!我只是……顺着他们来,好想办法逃出去!

lines.en: : Noooo — you were going along with it because that’s what you do. You’ve had opportunity after opportunity to really make yourself {i}stick out{/i} and you’ve squandered every single one.
lines.zh: : 不——你顺着他们来,是因为你本来就会这么做。你有过一次又一次让自己真正{i}脱颖而出{/i}的机会,而你把每一次都浪费掉了。

lines.en: : Not just at CompanyCorp. either! Your whole {i}life’s{/i} been fucking boring since you make sure all the highlights happen behind closed doors!
lines.zh: : 还不只是在 CompanyCorp.!你{i}这辈子{/i}都他妈的无聊透顶,因为你非要让所有精彩的部分都发生在关起门之后!

lines.en: : What do you know about my life?! You’re not even Ami, apparently! What do you {i}want{/i} me to do?!
lines.zh: : 你懂我的人生什么?!你明明连 Ami 都不是!你到底{i}想{/i}让我怎么做?!

lines.en: : The same thing I told the {i}last{/i} girl. And the one before that. {i}Something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 跟我对{i}上一个{/i}女孩说的一样。还有上上一个。{i}做点什么{/i}。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol31
: I had high hopes for you in the beginning, you know. You were one of the first girls to spread your legs for Aki-kun. Plus — Clam’s Tongue? Certified banger. Give me more of that.
lines.zh: : 一开始我对你期望很高的,你知道吗。你是最早为 Aki-kun 张开腿的女孩之一。而且——《蛤蜊的舌头》?公认的神作。多来点那种东西。

lines.en: : Ever since then, it’s just been “Woe is me. Blaaaah. I’m so fat. Blaaaah. How can I ever love someone when I, myself, can not {i}be{/i} loved? Blaaaaah.” Talk about static, right? Total snoozefest.
lines.zh: : 从那以后,就只剩下『呜呼哀哉。bla——。我好胖。bla——。连我自己都不{i}被爱{/i},我又怎么能去爱别人?bla——。』这就叫一成不变,懂吗?无聊到让人想睡觉。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol32
: You’re, like, not even that big either. You’re pretty normal by American standards, honestly.
lines.zh: : 而且你……也没那么胖吧。老实说,按美国标准你挺正常的。

lines.en: : I...I can’t help how I see myself...
lines.zh: : 我……我也控制不了自己怎么看自己……

lines.en: : I get that. But you’re using that as an excuse to prevent you from ever doing {i}anything{/i} when we both know there’s so much you actually {i}want{/i} to do.
lines.zh: : 这我懂。可你正拿这个当借口,好让自己永远{i}什么都不{/i}去做,而我们俩心里都清楚,你其实{i}想{/i}做的事多得是。

lines.en: : Be more aggressive. Start an OnlyFans account like that girl from Euphoria did and just totally crash out. Saves the universe the effort of having to crash out on your behalf, at the very least.
lines.zh: : 更主动一点。像《Euphoria》里那个女孩一样开个 OnlyFans 账号,然后彻底崩溃一场。至少能让宇宙省下替你崩溃的力气。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol33
: What?...What are you even-
lines.zh: : 什么?……你到底在-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol34
: “We are {i}all{/i} lost. And it is {i}your{/i} fault. {i}You{/i} did this. {i}You{/i} broke the world. And now you’re gonna try and pick up the pieces? Don’t make me laugh.”
lines.zh: : 『我们{i}都{/i}迷路了。而这都是{i}你的{/i}错。{i}是你{/i}干的。{i}是你{/i}毁了这个世界。现在你还想把碎片捡起来?别逗我笑了。』

lines.en: : “I hope you fucking choke on the next tongue unfortunate enough to slither into your mouth.”
lines.zh: : 『我希望你被下一条不幸滑进你嘴里的舌头活活呛死。』

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol35
: That was so cool! But you probably can’t even remember it because it’s not something {i}you{/i} chose to do!
lines.zh: : 那可太帅了!但{i}你{/i}大概根本不记得,因为那不是你主动选择去做的事!

lines.en: : In fact, any time you choose {i}anything,{/i} you give up halfway through and sink right back to the very bottom of the totem pole where you think you belong!
lines.zh: : 事实上,无论你选择{i}什么{/i},你都会半途而废,然后重新沉回图腾柱最底下那个你认为自己该待的位置!

lines.en: : With a mindset like that, it only makes sense that somewhere like {i}this{/i} is where you’d end up, right?!
lines.zh: : 抱着这种心态,你最后落到{i}这种地方{/i}也就说得通了,对吧?!

lines.en: : How do I change then?...
lines.zh: : 那我该怎么改变?……

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol36
: Like...if you have the answers, why don’t you just give them to me? Why sit here...and berate me about not getting it on my own? Huh?...
lines.zh: : 比如……如果你有答案,为什么不直接给我?为什么要坐在这里……指责我自己想不出来?嗯?……

lines.en: : If you have a pineapple and I {i}also{/i} have a pineapple, what happens if I give you my pineapple?
lines.zh: : 如果你有一个菠萝,我{i}也{/i}有一个菠萝,那我把我的菠萝给你,会发生什么?

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol37
: You have two pineapples, idiot!
lines.zh: : 你就有两个菠萝了,白痴!

lines.en: : What the fuck is that supposed to mean?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈到底是什么意思?!

lines.en: : It means that if you’d just look down, you’d remember you {i}have{/i} one already and you don’t need mine! But for some reason, you think the pineapple is fragile and are afraid to break it or something!
lines.zh: : 意思是你只要低头看看,就会想起自己本来就{i}有一个{/i},根本不需要我的!可不知道为什么,你觉得那颗菠萝很脆弱,怕把它弄坏什么的!

lines.en: : You know how you make things interesting, Futaba? You know what steps you can take to prevent winding up at CompanyCorp.? Because you {i}should!{/i} You’ve already tried walking up them!
lines.zh: : 你知道怎么让生活变得有趣吗,Futaba?你知道该怎么做才不至于最后落到 CompanyCorp. 这种地方吗?你{i}应该{/i}知道的!那些台阶你已经试着往上走过!

lines.en: : When?! How?!
lines.zh: : 什么时候?!怎么做?!

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol38
: Listen, you’re a cute girl. And I {i}like{/i} cute girls, so I’m going to let you in on a little secret.
lines.zh: : 听着,你是个可爱的女孩。而我{i}喜欢{/i}可爱的女孩,所以我给你透露一个小秘密。

lines.en: : If you love somebody, and you’re {i}sure{/i} you love them, you can {i}make{/i} them love you back.
lines.zh: : 如果你爱一个人,而且你{i}确定{/i}自己爱他,你就能{i}让{/i}他也爱上你。

lines.en: : I don’t want to {i}make{/i} anyone love me, though...I want them to do it on their own.
lines.zh: : 可我不想{i}让{/i}任何人爱我……我想让他们自己主动爱上我。

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol39
: And that, my girl, is what makes you boring. {i}Passivity.{/i} It’s like a book. Reading “A man was murdered by X” instead of a “X murdered a man” just doesn’t hit the same, you know?
lines.zh: : 而这就是让你无聊的地方,我的姑娘。{i}被动{/i}。就像一本书。读『一个男人被 X 杀了』和『X 杀了一个男人』,给人的感觉就是不一样,懂吗?

lines.en: : The people who find the most success out there and get to sit in high rise offices and {i}fire{/i} girls like you are the ones who understand that.
lines.zh: : 那些在外面混得最成功、能坐在高层办公室里{i}开除{/i}你这种女孩的人,都明白这个道理。

lines.en: : Who gives a shit if it “goes against your character” if it’s something that will make your character {i}better?{/i}
lines.zh: : 只要能让你的角色变得{i}更好{/i},管它『人设崩不崩』呢?

lines.en: : It’s not like I {i}want{/i} to hurt your feelings. I just {i}have{/i} to. Sort of like how Aki-kun had to when you tried to tell him you love him a trillion years ago. He’s pushing you. And guess who it was that taught him that?
lines.zh: : 我又不是{i}想{/i}伤你的心。我{i}不得不{/i}这么做而已。有点像很久很久以前你试着对 Aki-kun 说你爱他时,他不得不做的那样。他在逼你一把。你猜是谁教他这么做的?

lines.en: : Not {i}Ami,{/i} buuuuuut...
lines.zh: : 不是 {i}Ami{/i},不过——

lines.en: : You’re...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : You’re supposed to be dead...
lines.zh: : 你应该已经死了……

lines.en: : And you’re supposed to be a teenager. Big whoop. What’s your point?
lines.zh: : 而你应该还是个少女。那又怎样。你想说什么?

lines.en: : Are you the one who did this to me last time too?...When I woke up in that...weird school where everything was upside down?
lines.zh: : 上次也是你对我做的吗?……就是我醒来发现自己在一所……一切都颠倒过来的怪学校那次?

lines.en: : Not my style. I’m a lot more {i}hands-on{/i} than that.
lines.zh: : 不是我的风格。我做事可比那{i}亲力亲为{/i}多了。

lines.en: : Why, though? Why would I...imagine {i}you{/i} of all people to come out of nowhere and...try to spur me to action? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 为什么?为什么我会……偏偏想象出{i}你{/i}来,莫名其妙地……想刺激我采取行动?我不明白。

lines.en: : There’s a lot you don’t get yet. But you {i}can{/i} if you take the right steps. And that’s why I’m here.
lines.zh: : 你不懂的事还多着呢。但只要你走对路,你就{i}能{/i}懂。这就是我在这儿的原因。

lines.en: : So the next step is...to...{i}make{/i} Sensei love me?
lines.zh: : 所以下一步是……{i}让{/i} Sensei 爱上我?

lines.en: : It’s to make {i}yourself{/i} into someone who isn’t so easy to ignore. And if you’re confused about that, just take a look at what everyone around you is doing. {i}Stand out.{/i} Stop being an extra.
lines.zh: : 是让{i}你{/i}变成一个不那么容易被忽视的人。如果你不明白,就看看你周围的人都在做什么。{i}脱颖而出{/i}。别再当路人甲了。

lines.en: : I...I can try, but-
lines.zh: : 我……我可以试试,可是-

lines.en: scene futabaprotocol40
: Also, don’t talk to that Maya girl anymore. She’s a bad influence.
lines.zh: : 还有,别再跟那个 Maya 女孩来往了。她是个坏影响。

lines.en: : What?...
